children: On October 1, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that, due to noncompliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule and prior reverse splits totaling at least 250:1, it issued a Staff Delisting Determination. Unless the company appeals by October 8, 2026, trading will be suspended on October 12, 2026; the company intends to request a hearing, which will stay the suspension, and the stock continues to trade under HCTI.
